title: What patients with asthma share when no one listens: multimethod observational study of patient narratives on Reddit
core_idea: Retrospective multimethod analysis of public posts on the r/asthma subreddit over a one-year period to describe discussion topics and to identify sentiment and polarity in patient language using text lemmatization, structural topic modeling, and sentiment/polarity analysis.
tldr: Analyze one year of r/asthma posts with mixed text-analytic methods to map what patients discuss and the sentiments/polarity expressed.
